purpose: Portable candidate-owned career records and wallet interoperability boundaries.

w3c_vc_data_model_2_0.note: Use the holder/issuer/verifier model. An unsigned export must never be labeled cryptographically verified.

openid4vp_1_0.note: Presentation protocol support belongs at wallet/verifier integration boundaries.

openid4vci_1_0.note: Issuance integration requires an authorized issuer and real signing/key management.

trust_boundaries.wallet_registration: public holder DID and public protocol metadata only
trust_boundaries.portable_record: unsigned unless an approved cryptographic issuer signs it
trust_boundaries.verified_source_credentials: retain their original verification evidence and status
trust_boundaries.contact_data: excluded unless candidate explicitly opts in
